request.style: English, male baritone solo with subtle gospel choir backing, acoustic guitar, piano, upright bass, cello, warm and reverent mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
If I speak in tongues of angels
And have no love inside
I am only a clanging gong
With a sound that is wide
If I have the gift of prophecy
And know all mysteries
But have no love to offer
I am truly just nothing

[Chorus]
Love is patient and kind
Love does not envy or boast
It is not arrogant at all
Nor rude when it counts

[Verse]
It does not insist on its own way
It is not irritable
It keeps no record of wrongs
It is not self-absorbed
Love does not rejoice in wrongdoing
It rejoices with the truth
It bears all things for you
It believes in the light

[Chorus]
Love is patient and kind
Love does not envy or boast
It is not arrogant at all
Nor rude when it counts

[Bridge]
It hopes all things forever
It endures all things too
Love never ends with time
It remains true and new

[Outro]
Love never ends
Love is true
